stem:
The table shows the numbers of flowers of different colors in four vases.

Flowers in Vases

| Vase | Yellow | Red |
|------|---------|-----|
| Q    | 9       | 3   |
| R    | 15      | 5   |
| S    | 21      | 7   |
| T    | 27      | 9   |

Based on the relationship shown in the table, which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: There are 3 times as many yellow flowers as red flowers in each vase.

options.label: G
options.text: There are 9 times as many yellow flowers as red flowers in each vase.

options.label: H
options.text: There are 6 times as many yellow flowers as red flowers in each vase.

options.label: J
options.text: There are 11 times as many yellow flowers as red flowers in each vase.

visual_elements: Table with columns Vase, Yellow, Red and rows Q, 9, 3; R, 15, 5; S, 21, 7; T, 27, 9
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding and verifying the consistent ratio between yellow and red flowers across multiple rows in the table, which is more than direct recall but does not require multi-step problem solving.
